resources.name: budget_lines

fields.name: line_id
fields.description: Row ID. Naga: the row's ID on budget.naga.gov.ph. Ordinance books: city, year, page and sequence

fields.name: fund_sources
fields.description: Naga: funds the portal lists (e.g. SEF, GF), empty if the row's page wasn't read. Ordinance books: the fund printed on the sheet

fields.name: ps
fields.description: Personal services, PHP

fields.name: mooe
fields.description: Maintenance and other operating expenses, PHP

fields.name: co
fields.description: Capital outlay (plus financial expenses), PHP

fields.name: total
fields.description: Row total as published (or as machine-read), PHP

fields.name: place_level
fields.description: Finest place the source states: 'school' when the row names a school, 'city' when it names none

fields.description: Page of the ordinance PDF (ordinance books only)

fields.name: machine_read
fields.description: True when the figure was read by OCR from a scanned or printed PDF and hasn't been reviewed by a person
